name: 94. Bedrock web_search search_content_types stripping (bedrock-web-search-content-types)
description: Bedrock Mantle's OpenAI-compatible Responses surface rejects search_content_types on web_search tools with HTTP 400 ("The 'search_content_types' field is not supported for web search tools."). Bifrost now removes only that nested field while preserving the web_search tool and all other supported options. These cases pin the non-streaming and streaming Bedrock Mantle paths used by Codex. The non-streaming case inspects extra_fields.raw_request so a response that merely succeeds after dropping the entire tool cannot pass.

item.name: bedrock_mantle/openai.gpt-5.6-luna /v1/responses strips web_search search_content_types but keeps the tool - bedrock-web-search-content-types

item.name: bedrock_mantle/openai.gpt-5.6-luna /v1/responses streaming strips web_search search_content_types - bedrock-web-search-content-types

exec: pm.test('bedrock_mantle streaming web_search does not fail on search_content_types', function () {
pm.expect(text, 'unsupported nested field reached Mantle: ' + text).to.not.include("The 'search_content_types' field is not supported for web search tools.");
// A 200 stream can still end in an error frame or stop early, so the frames are parsed.
pm.test('bedrock_mantle streaming web_search produces SSE events', function () {
var errors = events.filter(function (ev) { return ev.type === 'error' || ev.type === 'response.failed' || ev.type === 'response.incomplete' || (!ev.type && ev.error); });
pm.expect(errors.length, 'stream ended in an error or incomplete event: ' + JSON.stringify(errors[0] || null).slice(0, 400)).to.equal(0);
pm.expect(events.some(function (ev) { return ev.type === 'response.completed'; }), 'no response.completed, so the stream was cut short: ' + text.slice(-400)).to.equal(true);
